svg.text: 🛡️ PTT Safety — Defense in Depth (SDD V2.46 · chapter 15)
Layer 0 decides whether the chain may key at all; layers 1-7 guarantee nothing can leave the radio stuck in TX.
LAYER 0 · PRECONDITION — unverified-model transmit gate (AD-019, NFR-067)

set_ptt(True) / set_tune(True) refuse on a model whose profile is not hardware-verified (IC-705/IC-7610/IC-7760, FTDX10/FTDX101D/FTDX101MP/FTX-1F) unless MRRC_ALLOW_UNVERIFIED_TX=1 — one warning per process, and PTT releases are never gated, so every layer below can always unkey.
❶ TOUCH-AND-HOLD UX · browser
touchstart → key; touchend / touchcancel / touchmove-out / mouseleave → release; touchId tracking prevents cross-touch interference; passive:false capture listeners fire first.
❷ STATE MACHINE LOCK · browser
ptt_manager.js: one in-flight transition at a time, watchdog armed on key, click suppression while TX, release wins over a racing key request.
❸ COMMAND PATH · /WSradio
{"type":"set","field":"ptt","value":false} → the backend's priority set command (FT-710/ASCII-CAT TX0; · CI-V 1C 00) preempts poll reads and is fire-and-forget.
❹ PTT WATCHDOG · browser
500 ms interval checks radioState.tx_status; up to 3 retries when the state still says TX, catching a lost TX0 or a lost state broadcast.
❺ DEAD-MAN SWITCH · server

force release when the last control client disconnects during TX, or when the TX-audio owner (the PTT client's uplink) disappears — ownership follows the PTT client, same-session reconnects replace it.
❻ MAX-TX WATCHDOG · server (opt-in)
MRRC_PTT_MAX_TX_SECONDS caps an unattended carrier and releases it; disabled by default, logged when it fires.
❼ PAGE-UNLOAD BEACONS · browser
beforeunload → sendBeacon(TX0) · pagehide → sendCommand('ptt', false) — covers tab close, navigation and mobile app switching.
❽ TX AUDIO STOP · server + browser
on release: stop the TX stream, clear the audio queue, send the 's:' marker — so no buffered mic audio keeps modulating after the carrier drops.
Removed: triple TX0 verify (200 ms ×3 after every release) — retired in V1.2 as redundant once layers 4-6 existed, and noisy on the CAT link.
Verified by tests: `tests/test_max_tx_watchdog.py`, `tests/test_unverified_tx_gate.py`, the frontend contract tests for ptt_manager/beacons, and the field evidence recorded in SDD 15.4.
Unverified models therefore key only after an explicit operator opt-in, and even then all eight guarantees below the gate stay in force.
